messages:
maya: Quick intake — new model 'marlin-8b' (EleutherX fork) for onboarding. Need perf + quant bring-up this week for a PLG demo next Tue. Target: hosted latency comparable to atlas7b (within 2x) and Dedicated throughput goal ~500 tok/s @4k ctx. Who can own perf and quant?

raj: Priority? replacing atlas7b or new mid-tier?

maya: Fills a mid-tier slot (not a replacement). Priority = high because demo relies on it. Suggested owners: @liam for perf, @sara for quant.

liam: I'll take perf. Plan: run ctx sweep [512,1024,2048,4096], batch sweep [1,2,4,8,16,32], devices A100 and H100. Baseline bf16 then PTQ int8 (and an int8 QAT if quick wins appear). Command I'll use for bench runs:
```
python bench.py --model marlin-8b --dtype bf16 --device a100 --ctx 4096 --bs 1 --profile perf --out s3://redwood-bench/marlin-8b/bf16-run.json
python bench.py --model marlin-8b --quant int8 --device a100 --ctx 4096 --bs 16 --profile perf --out s3://redwood-bench/marlin-8b/int8-run.json
```
Will post short summary to this thread + raw logs.

sara: I'll own quant. Proposed quant path: PTQ with per-channel symmetric, per-axis scaling. Try double-check calibration set (1000 prompts from eval-regress-llm-v1). If PTQ regresses >1.5% on our quality slice, try a quick QAT (5k steps) and re-eval. Also want a small pass with GPTQ-style kernels to compare latency.

perf-bot: bf16 @A100 (bs=1, ctx=4096): 118 tok/s, p50 latency 135ms. int8 @A100 (bs=16, ctx=4096): 420 tok/s, p50 latency 45ms. H100 numbers coming. Raw logs uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/marlin-8b/prelim/1893456789/

maya: Nice — can we add rollout policy if int8 quality delta >1.5%? Fallback plan: hosted keep bf16, Dedicated can offer int8 opt-in. Also please open an infra ticket to reserve short Dedicated smoke slot (INF-2029 suggested). :thumbsup:

liam: Opening INF-2029 now and pinging infra. Uploading full logs + perf dashboards. ETA EOD today.

sara: Note on eval: run regress-llm-v1 + rouge/qa-acc slices. Thresholds: rouge drop <=2% and qa-acc drop <=1.5% to pass for canary. If exceeded, block int8 rollout.

maya: Great — I'll draft canary plan: 5% traffic int8 for 24h, auto-rollback if regression detected or error rate up >0.5%. Adding owners to bench board and the demo checklist. Thanks all :rocket:
